location_description: Kutztown (Pennsylvania German: Kutzeschteddel) is a borough in Berks County, Pennsylvania. It is located 18 miles (29 km) southwest of Allentown and 17 miles (27 km) northeast of Reading. As of the 2010 census, the borough had a population of 5,012.
